scopeDefinition: Primary display universe: UCLs with 100-1,499 usual residents, excluding special/non-settlement records. This is a Tiny Towns Atlas product definition, not an ABS definition of a town. The companion Diabetology manuscript analyses UCLs with at least 200 usual residents. The Atlas displays a distinct universe of 1,208 towns with 100-1,499 usual residents and includes additional Census health indicators and broader-area hospitalisation context; it is a related resource, not a replication or validation of the manuscript's findings.
